cues.en: We start off playing Adam Jensen.

cues.en: or give you new abilities.

cues.en: So you're escorting your head researcher/girlfriend to a conference

cues.en: when--whoops! Terrorists have attacked the building and you need to stop them.

cues.en: Well... you don't. Instead they kick your ass six months to Sunday

cues.en: and you're rushed to intensive care

cues.en: Months later, you've recovered and are going back to work

cues.en: From there, more questions are raised

cues.en: about why the hell your company keeps getting attacked so much

cues.en: Although, I feel like Montréal here shouldn't count

cues.en: because the whole thing is one just big office building. This could be anywhere.

cues.en: Quick! Can you spot the difference?

cues.en: They're just including Montréal because that's where the game was developed.

cues.en: Well, they wouldn't be the first company to do that.

cues.zh: 这里我没太多可说的，因为已经相当不错了。
cues.en: I don't have too much to say here because it's pretty good.

cues.en: It feels like a refinement and more thought out.

cues.en: I'd say the game might even be a little harder,

cues.en: In almost any other first-person shooter,

cues.en: you could take down these guys like they're balloon animals.

cues.en: Not here. They shoot back--bam, you're dead.

cues.en: People also detect you faster than the original,

cues.en: and they didn't dumb down the RPG complexity. It's a winner.

cues.en: The only things I didn't like about the gameplay are all minor.

cues.en: Sometimes there are invisible edges you can't shoot through.

cues.en: Also in the game, you can get a social augmentation

cues.en: where you confront some characters and try to persuade them to do something.

cues.en: I didn't like this because your responses and their reactions feel a little random.

cues.en: Some people you're supposed to mix up compassionate and understanding responses

cues.en: Look at these. These responses say practically the same thing.

cues.en: It's like being penalized for saying "Good day" instead of "How do you do?"

cues.en: I'd rather just cut the crap and tell characters what I think

cues.en: and have them react like normal human beings.

cues.en: This feels a little unnatural and way hazier.

cues.en: Another thing is that the button for looting is a little too sensitive

cues.en: and I found myself firing my gun half the time

cues.en: while looting the body like a manic kleptomaniac.

cues.en: Oh boy, oh boy! He's got stuff! HE'S GOT STUFF!

cues.en: And finally, I am sorry to say,

cues.en: I consider the body moving mechanics a downgrade from the former games.

cues.en: You can only limply drag them now.

cues.en: This is a missed opportunity here, folks.

cues.en: But the game almost makes up for that by having takedown moves.

cues.en: You can walk up to people and take them out in one move.

cues.en: Now they have both lethal and non-lethal moves,

cues.en: but honestly, I found the non-lethal methods way more fun.

cues.en: We have chokeholds and some throws, but it's really the punching that stuck with me.

cues.en: They go a little overboard but it's really great

cues.en: And on top of all that,

cues.en: This isn't really what comes to mind

cues.en: when I think of the word "mercy" but sure, I'll take it. 20 points.

cues.en: Some of the gameplay is a little more simplified

cues.en: like removing area damage and leaning,

cues.en: but I don't feel like I'm being robbed the way I was with "Invisible War"

cues.en: especially since the combat is so fluid now.

cues.en: I give it a thumbs up.

cues.en: I wish I could say the same about the graphics.

cues.en: Now you might be thinking, "What are you talking about? These graphics are great!"

cues.en: And they are...

cues.en: ...if you're color blind.

cues.en: I know this has been brought up a bunch elsewhere,

cues.zh: 但我真的没法无视这个问题。
cues.en: but I seriously can't ignore this.

cues.zh: 这游戏是黄色的。或者黄橙色……金色，随便吧。这就是抠字眼。
cues.en: This game is yellow. Or yellow-orange... gold, whatever. That's just splitting hairs.

cues.zh: 重点是，它被染色调得过分了。
cues.en: The point is, it is tinted to hell and back.

cues.zh: 其实我不太确定到底是怎么回事
cues.en: Actually, I'm not completely sure what's going on

cues.zh: 因为我试着关掉后处理
cues.en: because I tried turning post-processing off

cues.zh: 这对某些地方有帮助，对其他一些地方没什么用。
cues.en: and that helps some things, didn't do much for others.

cues.zh: 我认为正在发生的是，美术给贴图加上了
cues.en: What I think is happening is the artist has taken a texture,

cues.zh: 一点点黄色色调，
cues.en: added a small shade of yellow to that,

cues.zh: 然后很多时候，映射器又给关卡加了黄色光源，
cues.en: then in many cases, the mapper adds a yellow light to the level,

cues.zh: 接着又在这之上给整张地图加了黄色雾效，
cues.en: then adds a yellow fog to the entire map on top of that,

cues.zh: 最后游戏又在这之上叠加了一层黄色色调。
cues.en: and then finally, the game adds a yellow tinting on top of that.

cues.zh: 我看到了未来，它是黄色的。
cues.en: I have seen the future and it is yellow.

cues.zh: 我试过用 mod 来修正这个问题，
cues.en: I tried using mods to correct this,

cues.zh: 但这只是把事情推向了另一个极端。
cues.en: but it just pushes things too far in the other direction.

cues.zh: 这太深入了，我不确定能否干净地分离出来。
cues.en: This is so invasive, I'm not sure it's possible to separate cleanly.

cues.zh: 现在如果你只是粗略地看一眼，可能会觉得这看起来温暖又好看。
cues.en: Now if you just look at this briefly, you might think this looks warm and nice.

cues.zh: 但不行。给一张风格化的照片上色是一回事，
cues.en: But no. It's one thing to tint a stylized photo,

cues.zh: 给一个30小时游戏疯狂上色就是另一回事了。
cues.en: it's another thing to tint the HELL out of a 30-hour game.

cues.zh: 你有没有在晴天去过雪地里
cues.en: Have you ever been out in the snow on a sunny day

cues.zh: 然后回到暗的房间时，所有东西看起来都有点发紫？
cues.en: then when you come back into a dark room, everything looks kind of purple?

cues.zh: 如果我玩这个游戏够久，我也会稍微有这种感觉。
cues.en: Well if I play this game long enough, that happens to me slightly.

cues.zh: 导演剪辑版确实试着把黄色调淡了一点，
cues.en: Now the director's cut did try to tone down the yellow tinting a bit,

cues.zh: 但接着他们又换成了浑浊的灰色滤镜。搞什么？
cues.en: but then they replaced it with a muddy gray filter. What the hell?

cues.zh: 为什么艺术总监们痴迷于给一切疯狂上色？
cues.en: Why are art directors obsessed with tinting the hell out of everything?

cues.zh: 他们的眼睛和我的运作方式不一样吗？
cues.en: Do their eyes work differently than mine?

cues.zh: 我看到最近《神鬼寓言：周年纪念版》也加上了这种恶心的灰色调。
cues.en: I saw this nasty gray tint added recently to "Fable: Anniversary Edition" also.

cues.zh: 原版现在看起来更好。
cues.en: The original looks better now.

cues.zh: 为什么这种事一再发生？
cues.en: Why does this keep happening?

cues.zh: 我并不反对黄色。
cues.en: I'm not against the color yellow.

cues.en: In fact, this game has a lot of street lamps at night.

cues.en: Yeah, that should be yellowish orange, but why EVERYTHING?

cues.zh: 着色应该像调味料，留到闪回片段再用。
cues.en: Tinting should be like a spice. Save it for a flashback sequence.

cues.zh: 或者，游戏里中枪时屏幕变红，那就是很好的用法。
cues.en: Or hey, in the game when you get shot, the screen turns red. That's a good use of it.

cues.zh: 给整个游戏上色，就像往菜里倒了两杯肉豆蔻。
cues.en: Tinting the ENTIRE GAME is like dumping two cups of nutmeg into your dish.

cues.zh: 会出人命的。
cues.en: You'll kill people.

cues.zh: 想为这个辩护的人，如果每个游戏都这么干呢？
cues.en: For anyone trying to defend this, what if every game did this?

cues.en: This game came out in 2011.

cues.en: Imagine if the industry decided yellow filters were the hot new thing

cues.zh: 还把它当成“艺术愿景”的一部分，
cues.en: and part of their "artistic vision",

cues.zh: 于是那年每个游戏都被硬加上黄色滤镜。
cues.en: so every game that year had a yellow filter slapped on it.

cues.zh: 你会觉得业界疯了。那为什么这个游戏就该被放过？
cues.en: You'd think the industry would've gone insane. So why should this game get a pass?

cues.zh: 或者，两全其美的办法，给我一个关掉它的选项？
cues.en: Or hey, how about the best of both worlds and just give me an OPTION to turn it off?

cues.zh: 这样大家就都赢了。
cues.en: Then everybody wins.

cues.en: Speaking of 2011 games, there was actually a color mod released for "Battlefield 3"

cues.en: that restored the color to the game to make it more natural.

cues.zh: 然后DICE开始封禁用这个mod的人，
cues.en: Well, DICE started banning people for using the mod

cues.zh: 说它“色彩太多”，给了玩家不公平的优势。
cues.en: because they said it had "too much color" and gave people an unfair advantage.

cues.zh: 后来他们改主意说没问题，
cues.en: Then they changed their minds and said it was okay

cues.zh: 还会加一个选项来去掉色调。
cues.en: and would be adding an option to remove the color tinting.

cues.zh: 但接着他们又改主意了，
cues.en: But then they changed their mind again

cues.zh: 说带色调的画面才是未来趋势，
cues.en: saying that tinted screens were the way of the future

cues.zh: 并且会继续封禁试图改动它的人。
cues.en: and will continue to ban people trying to change it.

cues.en: and one that came up was that there are secretly lizard people among us.

cues.en: If you need an ending but you're running out of time or budget

cues.zh: 又做不起过场动画，
cues.en: and can't afford a cinematic,

cues.zh: 那就找你的美术，反正他们在制作后期通常活儿也不多，
cues.en: you grab your artists, who usually have less work towards the end of production anyway,

cues.zh: 让他们给你赶几张概念图。
cues.en: and ask them whip up some concept stills for you.

cues.zh: 然后给我们放个幻灯片，展示你“想要”发生什么，再配上配音。
cues.en: Then you give us a slideshow showing what you WANTED to happen and add voices to that.

cues.zh: 顺便再加点特别廉价的动画和滚动效果。
cues.en: Maybe add some real cheap animations and scrolling effects while you're at it.

cues.zh: “Panchaea被摧毁了！哦不！”
cues.en: "Panchaea is destroyed! Oh no!"

cues.zh: 咕噜咕噜咕噜……
cues.en: Glub glub glub...

cues.zh: 好了。我刚给了你一个比这游戏更好的结局。
cues.en: There. I just gave you a better ending than this game has.

cues.zh: 对我来说，《杀出重围》的视频就到此为止了，那么《杀出重围》接下来会走向何方？
cues.en: And this is ending the Deus Ex videos for me, so where's Deus Ex going from here?

cues.zh: 当然，现实是《人类分裂》已经发布了，
cues.en: Now of course, the reality is "Mankind Divided" has been released,

cues.zh: 而且很可能还会引出另一部续作。
cues.en: and will probably lead to another sequel also.

cues.zh: 我还没玩过，但我的预测是它会大同小异。
cues.en: I haven't played it yet but my prediction is it'll be more of the same.

cues.zh: 我读到剧情是在强化改造这一主题，
cues.en: I've read the plot is doubling down on augmentations

cues.zh: 并影射当前的热点事件，这完全是个错误。
cues.en: and making parallels to current trending events, which is a total mistake.

cues.zh: 《杀出重围》需要展望未来，而不是关注当下。
cues.en: Deus Ex needs to look to the FUTURE, not the present.

cues.zh: 所以我认为续作在故事上仍然达不到要求，
cues.en: So I think the sequel still won't get it as far as the story,

cues.zh: 会继续拥有华丽的美术设计，
cues.en: will continue to have lavish art design,

cues.zh: 而且可能仍然有有趣的机制。
cues.en: and probably still have fun mechanics.

cues.zh: 所以就像这样——一款好玩的游戏，但并没有真正扛起《杀出重围》的大旗。
cues.en: So like this--an enjoyable game but not really carrying the Deus Ex banner.

cues.zh: 这就是我们目前的结局，但我更想看到的是这些结局。
cues.en: So that's our current ending, but here are the endings I'd like to see instead.

cues.zh: 1. 让 Eidos Montreal 终结《杀出重围》
cues.en: 1. Have Eidos Montreal kill Deus Ex

cues.zh: 转而做一款超酷的《攻壳机动队》或《阿基拉》风格的游戏。
cues.en: and make some bad ass Ghost in the Shell or Akira-inspired game instead.

cues.zh: 我觉得大家都会更开心。
cues.en: I think everyone will be happier for it.

cues.zh: 2. 想办法做一款外传游戏
cues.en: 2. Figure out a way for a side story game to work

cues.zh: 围绕科技丧尸末日展开，因为听起来太棒了。
cues.en: involving a techno-zombie apocalypse, because this sounds awesome.

cues.zh: 或者，做一款潜行格斗游戏，包含大量处决动作
cues.en: Alternately, make a stealth-brawler game involving tons of takedowns

cues.zh: 把所有人打得落花流水。
cues.en: and beating the crap out of everyone.

cues.zh: 这两个方案我都喜欢。
cues.en: These are both winners for me.

cues.zh: 3. 让另一家工作室来做《杀出重围》的真正续作。
cues.en: 3. Have another studio make the true successor to Deus Ex.

cues.zh: 尽量做一款能预测未来的游戏。
cues.en: Try to make a game that will predict the future as best we can.

cues.zh: 你看，有很多事情我们无法预测，
cues.en: See, there's a lot of things we can't predict,

cues.zh: 但有些事情我们完全能预测，只是不知道什么时候发生。
cues.en: but there are some things we can totally predict. We just don't know when.

cues.zh: 这件事你几乎至少需要两个编剧。
cues.en: You would almost want at least two writers for this.

cues.zh: 一个负责编出有趣好玩的故事
cues.en: One to make a fun and interesting story

cues.zh: 另一个负责向不同领域的众多专家做大量研究
cues.en: and one to do a ton of research from various experts in different fields

cues.zh: 弄清楚这个世界会是什么样子，并预测我们将走向何方。
cues.en: to figure out what this world would look like and predict where we're going.

cues.zh: 所以我们会研究过往数据、预测模型和趋势，
cues.en: So we would look at past data, predictive models and trends,

cues.zh: 尽力推断50年后会发生什么
cues.en: to try our best to figure out what will be happening in 50 years

cues.zh: 包括经济、能源、技术、环境、政府等等。
cues.en: with the economy, energy, technology, our environment, governments and so on.

cues.zh: 然后基于充分调研做出我们最好的推测，判断未来会是什么样。
cues.en: Then really take our best educated guess as to what's on the horizon.

cues.zh: 再把这个世界观包装进一款正常又好玩的游戏里，你就得到了《杀出重围》的续作。
cues.en: Then package that world into a normal fun game and you have a Deus Ex successor.

cues.zh: 归根结底，现在的生活方式完全不可持续
cues.en: The bottom line is, life right now is totally not sustainable

cues.zh: 而且它无论如何都会发生变化，
cues.en: and it's going to change one way or another,

cues.zh: 所以能多窥见一点未来的样子会很有意义。
cues.en: so it would be great to get more of a glimpse of what that looks like.

cues.zh: 奖项！
cues.en: Awards!

cues.zh: 第一个奖项——点石成金艺术设计奖。
cues.en: First award-- King Midas art design.

cues.zh: 尽管玩法有趣，但仅凭这一点就让我不想重玩这款游戏。
cues.en: Despite having fun mechanics, this alone makes me not want to replay the game.

cues.zh: 你没法把痛苦粉饰掉。
cues.en: You can't tint the pain away.

cues.zh: 身份危机。这款游戏想成为别的东西。
cues.en: Identity crisis. This game wants to be something else.

cues.zh: 这并不完全是开发者的错。
cues.en: Now this isn't completely the developer's fault.

cues.zh: 《隐形战争》让他们陷入困境，因为它完全走向了科幻
cues.en: Invisible War kind of screwed them by going complete sci-fi

cues.zh: 所以他们没法做一个写实的续作。
cues.en: so they couldn't make a realistic sequel.

cues.zh: 而前传通常不是最好的
cues.en: And prequels usually aren't the best

cues.zh: 因为除非你想办法走向完全不同的方向，
cues.en: because unless you figure out a way to go in a completely different direction,

cues.zh: 否则你已经知道结局会怎样了。
cues.en: you already know how it's going to end up.

cues.zh: 《杀出重围》讲的是改变世界的事件，而在前传里你能改变的有限。
cues.en: Deus Ex is about world changing events, and you can only change so much in a prequel.

cues.zh: 这款游戏想成为《合金装备》遇上《攻壳机动队》的《阿基拉》黄色《银翼杀手》版
cues.en: This game wants to be Metal Ghost in the Akira of Yellow Bladerunner Edition

cues.zh: 我觉得他们干脆抛弃《杀出重围》，直接去做那个算了。
cues.en: and I think they should just ditch Deus Ex and go for that instead.

cues.zh: 最后——还需要更多变异。
cues.en: And finally-- Further mutations required.

cues.zh: 《隐形战争》是《杀出重围》的一个变异，而这个是另一个不同的变异。
cues.en: Invisible War was a mutation from Deus Ex, and this is a different one.

cues.zh: 挺好玩，但在我看来，《杀出重围》已经死了。
cues.en: It's fun, but as far as I'm concerned, Deus Ex is dead.

cues.zh: 已经没有足够的空间把它做成那么惊艳的东西了。
cues.en: There's not enough room to make it into something as awesome anymore.

cues.zh: 时间线现在锁得太死了。
cues.en: The timeline is just too locked down now.

cues.zh: 它需要在另一个 IP 中重生，或者彻底重启。
cues.en: It needs to be reborn in another IP or else completely rebooted.

cues.zh: Adam Jensen 的故事本质上是有局限的。
cues.en: The tale of Adam Jensen is inherently limited.

cues.zh: 《杀出重围》系列剧集到此结束。
cues.en: And that is the end of the Deus Ex episodes.

cues.zh: 天哪！“Spiderbot”加上三部《杀出重围》。这现实对我来说够多了。
cues.en: Man! "Spiderbot" and three Deus Exes. That's enough reality for me.

cues.zh: 敬请期待下一集，来点更轻松的。
cues.en: Stay tuned for the next episode for something lighter.

cues.zh: 带颜色的。
cues.en: With colors.

cues.zh: 还有一个好结局！
cues.en: And a good ending!

cues.zh: BLAGH！
cues.en: BLAGH!

cues.zh: 嗯。
cues.en: Hm.

cues.zh: 哦，我差点忘了。
cues.en: Oh, I almost forgot.

cues.zh: 记住。聪明购物，就去 S-Mart。
cues.en: Remember. Shop smart, shop S-Mart.
